capabilities: Cite Zotero items in notes using [@citekey] syntax with an autocomplete popup
Tie a note's bibliography to a Zotero collection via a bib frontmatter property
List cited references or the whole collection's bibliography in a sidebar view
Browse and review PDF annotations from Zotero in one pane, including image annotations
Jump to referenced PDFs and annotations in Zotero and copy cited annotations to clipboard
extras: Discloses no payments, accounts, network use, external file access, ads, or telemetry; installable via the BRAT beta plugin; accepted into the official community plugin store in December 2025.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to cite items from a Zotero library or view its PDF annotations while writing research notes.

relations.evidence: cite and refer to the literature stored in your Reference Manager Library (Zotero)

requires.name: Zotero 7 with the Better BibTeX plugin

summary: Zotero integration that lets you cite references in Pandoc syntax and review their PDF annotations from a sidebar while taking notes.
